title: 第21章 未来之路第22章 卿向潇湘我向秦
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
未来之路
清风城
“清风道长，我们无意冒犯。”圣女连忙恭敬说道。
“不是说李清风死了吗？做的什麽垃圾情报，这下完犊子了。”圣女在内心对白莲教的分堂一通臭骂。
“我们如此陷害圣女，是不是”
“叫圣女就是下任教主了？鹿死谁手还未可知，我们的主子才应该是最後的赢家。”
“红莲种，白莲教，当我李家死的？”李清风意味不明的说道。
“清风道长，这是红莲之种，请笑纳。”圣女闻言瞳孔一缩，连忙上前恭敬的递过一个小盒子。
“你倒是聪明伶俐，可以走了。”李清风接过盒子，轻笑。
“你们应该庆幸我已经出来了，否则”李清风把盒子抛起，戏谑开口。
“天地剑门开启的时候，用名额来换红莲种。”李清风淡淡道。
“谢过清风道人。”圣女闻言大松一口气，躬身拱手。
“你们可以走了。”李清风一甩拂尘，飘然而去。
马车上
“该死的，分堂有诡。”圣女咬破嘴唇，妖艳的血迹让红唇变得十分诱人。
“圣女，区区观山境界，我们也不必如此卑微吧？”红衣女子在马车上马後炮。
“是，我们这里是哪里？”圣女看着红衣女子，一副你是傻子吗的眼神。
“剑南道。”红衣女子应着。
“你也知道这里是边疆剑南，非得等到行军大总管来了你才认是吧？”圣女无语了。
“是奴婢自大了。”红衣女子连忙道歉。

“黑莲你找死”圣女看着远处的夜空，眼中杀意闪烁。
楚家
“已经完事了？”李清风看着下面的残肢断臂与血气冲霄的骇人场面，意外了一下。
他本以为楚老狗起码还能苟延残喘一会的。
“直接就被吸死了？”李清风看着手里的盒子摇了摇头。
“白莲教这种两面三刀的教派也敢与之为伍，不知是心大还是脑残。”李清风一挥拂尘，转身离开。
身後的楚家诉说着一段血腥往事。
大厅
“都下去休息吧，慎行你等等。”李毅年看着李君肃。
等到人都离开后，大长老他们连身上的衣服都没来得及换，一个个都盯着李君肃，像看什麽宝贝疙瘩一样。
“家主，长老，还有什麽事吗？”李君肃被看得头皮发麻，一拱手说着。
“慎行，你想不想加入六扇门？”李毅年看着李君肃。
“六扇门？”李君肃一怔。
“慎行，这六扇门就是个魔窟，去不得！”大长老闻言率先开口。
“六扇门是朝廷掌管江湖的一把刀，十分凶险不错，但里面的资源也足够丰富。”门外传来儒雅的声音。
“大哥”大长老他们一个个都缩了缩脖子。
“雕鴞，你可知这江湖有多大？”李清风慢悠悠的走到主位旁边坐下，看着下方的李君肃。
他不知道自家的废物点心儿子什麽想法，还莫念，说不定这小猛禽对李家半点想法都没有。
“不知。”李君肃摇了摇头。
他确实对这些一无所知，现在也是到了选择的时候。

“江湖之大，天圆地方皆有小门小派，不过这大派也就这麽多。”李清风说着，而後一挥拂尘。
绝生九境无处还，八帮七楼六魔头。
五剑四佛三道门，开国皇帝平乱世。
“八帮七楼就比较杂，谁都说自己是其中之一。”李毅年吐槽一句。
“这六魔门分别是天魔宫丶魇魔殿丶白莲教丶圣火教丶欢喜庙与已经灭亡的血饮门。”三长老摸着胡须。
content_en:
The road ahead
Qingfeng City
"Taoist Master Qingfeng, we have no intention of offending." The saint said quickly and respectfully.
"Didn't you say that Qingfeng Li is dead? What kind of rubbish information did you create? It's all over now." The saint cursed the branch of the White Lotus Sect in her heart.
"We framed the Saint like this, didn't we?"
"Call the Holy Girl the next leader? It's still unclear who will win. Our master should be the final winner."
"Red Lotus, White Lotus, do you think my Li family died?" Li Qingfeng said with unclear meaning.
"Taoist Priest Qingfeng, this is the red lotus seed, please accept it." The saint's pupils shrank when she heard this, and she quickly stepped forward and respectfully handed over a small box.
"You are quite smart, you can go now." Qingfeng Li took the box and chuckled.
"You should be lucky that I have come out, otherwise" Qingfeng Li threw up the box and said jokingly.
"When the Heaven and Earth Sword Gate opens, use your quota in exchange for red lotus seeds." Li Qingfeng said calmly.
"Thank you, Taoist Qingfeng." The saint heard the words and breathed a sigh of relief, bowed and held her hands.
"You can go." Qingfeng Li flicked his fly whisk and floated away.
on carriage
"Damn it, there's something fishy about the branch." The saint bit her lip, and the coquettish blood stains made her red lips very attractive.
"Holy girl, we don't have to be so humble if we are only in the mountain-viewing realm, right?" The woman in red got on the carriage and made an afterthought.
"Yes, where are we here?" The saint looked at the woman in red with a look like "Are you a fool?"
"Jiannan Road." The woman in red responded.
"You also know that this is the border area of ​​Jiannan. You have to wait until the marching general manager comes to recognize it, right?" The saint was speechless.
"This slave is arrogant." The woman in red apologized quickly.
"Heilian, you are seeking death." The saint looked at the night sky in the distance, murderous intent flashing in her eyes.
Chu family
"Is it over already?" Li Qingfeng was surprised when he looked at the horrifying scene of broken limbs and bloody limbs below.
He thought that Old Dog Chu could at least survive for a while.
"You were sucked to death right away?" Li Qingfeng looked at the box in his hand and shook his head.
"I don't know if a duplicitous sect like the White Lotus dares to associate with them. I wonder if it's because of a big heart or a stupid brain." Li Qingfeng waved his whisk and turned to leave.
The Chu family behind him tells a bloody past.
lobby
"Go down and rest, please be careful and wait." Li Yinian looked at Li Junsu.
After everyone left, the elder and the others didn't even have time to change their clothes. They all stared at Li Junsu as if they were looking at some precious pimple.
"Master, elder, is there anything else you can do?" Li Junsu said, his scalp numb at the sight.
"Shen Xing, do you want to join the Six Sects?" Li Yinian looked at Li Junsu.
"Six doors?" Li Junsu was startled.
"Be careful, these six doors are a devil's cave, you can't go there!" The great elder spoke first upon hearing this.
"The six gates are a knife used by the imperial court to control the world. They are very dangerous, but the resources inside are also rich enough." An elegant voice came from outside the door.
"Big Brother" and the elders all shrank their necks.
"Diao Owl, do you know how big this world is?" Li Qingfeng slowly walked to the main seat and sat down, looking at Li Junsu below.
He didn't know what his useless snack son thought, so he didn't think about it. Maybe the little raptor didn't have any thoughts about the Li family.
"I don't know." Li Junsu shook his head.
He really knew nothing about any of this, and now it was time to make a choice.
"The world is so vast that there are small sects and sects everywhere, but there are only so many big sects." Li Qingfeng said, and then waved his whisk.
There is nowhere to return to the Juesheng Nine Realms, and there are eight gangs and six demons on the seventh floor.
Five swords, four Buddhas and three gates, the founding emperor calmed the troubled times.
"The Eighth Gang and the Seventh Floor are more complex, and everyone says that they are one of them." Li Yinian complained.
"The six demon sects are the Heavenly Demon Palace, Nightmare Demon Palace, White Lotus Sect, Holy Fire Sect, Huanxi Temple and the extinct Blood Drinking Sect."The third elder stroked his beard.
